blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.apiKey` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This methods retrieves a paginated list of API keys. It sends a request to the 
[List API Keys](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#api-keys\_getapikeys) API route.
